steps.title: Understand the Fab
steps.description: Follow the heavy and light variable/constant domains. Select Fv or Fab to see their actual sequence ranges.

steps.title: Inspect heavy-chain CDR3
steps.description: Read IMGT positions and original input coordinates. Compare human germline reference candidates below the alignment controls.

steps.title: See the experimental complex
steps.description: PDB 1N8Z contains the Herceptin Fab bound to HER2. The selected CDR3 is highlighted; contacts use a stated distance threshold.

steps.title: Compare a local prediction
steps.description: The gold model is the computed Fv. Fit: 91 heavy-chain framework Cα pairs. Evaluation: 13 CDR3 pairs. The antigen is absent from the predicted model.

superposition.missingPolicy: exclude residues without corresponding Cα in both structures

steps.title: Inspect the local surface profile
steps.description: Explore the computed Fv hydrophobic and charged-residue surface areas and connected patches. These independent descriptors are not TAP scores or pass/fail thresholds.

steps.title: Explore human-reference similarity
steps.description: Inspect OASis peptide matches and select a published TAP reference metric. Published populations are separate from uncomputed candidate TAP scores.

steps.title: Keep the evidence
steps.description: Read source records, add an observation, and save your own copy. The original public-data example stays unchanged.
